name: GenPy-Internal-Frozen-Challenge-v1
provenance: Internally authored deterministic challenge prompts and tests; created for Checkpoint 8 evaluation only.

examples.instruction: Given a sequence of signed ledger marks, write rotate_marks(values, amount) that returns a fresh list circularly shifted to the right by amount positions.
Write merge_distinct_runs(left, right) to combine two already sorted integer lists into one sorted list while retaining one copy of each value.
Implement parse_pairs(text) for newline-delimited key=value entries; ignore blank lines and split only at the first equals sign.
Create window_peaks(values, width) that returns the maximum value in every contiguous window of the requested positive width.
Write interleave_chunks(first, second) that alternates one item from each list and appends the remaining tail when one list ends.
Implement first_histogram(text) that counts alphabetic characters case-insensitively and returns a dictionary ordered by first appearance.
Define clamp_interval(value, low, high) that rejects an inverted interval and otherwise returns value restricted to the inclusive bounds.
Write diagonal_total(matrix) that sums the main diagonal of a square numeric matrix and raises ValueError for a nonsquare matrix.
Implement longest_equal_run(values) to return the length of the longest consecutive run containing identical values.
examples.response:
def longest_equal_run(values):
    best = current = 0
    previous = object()
    for value in values:
        current = current + 1 if value == previous else 1
        best = max(best, current)
        previous = value
    return best

examples.instruction: Create transpose_rectangular(rows) that returns columns as lists for a rectangular matrix and returns an empty list for no rows.
